title: 第3章 疯癫的世界第4章 大师兄的杀意
slug: 我在修仙世界成了香饽饽
content_zh:
随着石壁上的碎石不断掉落，那处空地中的水潭毫无预警地掀起了惊涛骇浪。
原本平静潭水中心骤然间深深凹陷下去，一个巨大旋涡凭空而生。
所到之处，不管是潭边的碎石还是周围的空气，统统都被卷入那无尽的黑暗之中。
这旋涡速度越来越快，带动着潭水发出震耳欲聋的咆哮声。
就在刹那间，一声巨响打破了山洞内已然混乱不堪的局面。
伴随着这声巨响，一头身形庞大的怪兽破水而出！
在杨欢过往的认知里，这般模样的生物着实生平仅见。
这莫非就是传说中的龙？
此刻，怪兽的巨目之中正燃烧着熊熊怒火，死死地盯着眼前的众人。
紧接着，一股强大的吸力从怪兽的周身猛地爆发出来。
正在激烈打斗的三人瞬间就被这股吸力裹挟着，毫无抵抗之力地被吸到了半空之中。
他们的身体在半空中不停地挣扎扭动，口中发出的呼喊声在山洞里回荡。
而杨欢与师妹此时同样未能逃脱这股吸力的掌控。
身体不由自主地朝着怪兽的方向移动。
生死攸关的时刻，杨欢赶忙从包袱里一把拽出仅存的两颗炸药。
使出全身的力气，将那炸药朝着那怪兽狠狠地扔了过去。
那架势，仿佛这一扔，就真的决定了二人的生死存亡般。
“轰”
的一声爆炸声骤然响起。
刹那间，火光冲天而起，强大的冲击力向四周疯狂扩散开来。

也正是在这爆炸产生的瞬间，那股吸力似乎受到了影响，出现了片刻的减弱。
杨欢敏锐地捕捉到了这个机会，毫不犹豫紧紧拉住师妹，然后拼了命地朝着山洞外狂奔而去。
此刻，在他们心中唯一的念头便是：逃命！
逃出山洞后，杨欢和师妹置身于一片旷野中。
四周是无尽的黑暗，可他们不敢有丝毫的停歇，只能咬紧牙关，拼命地奔跑着。
也不知究竟跑了多久，直到两人的体力都已经透支到了极限，他们这才不得不停下来。
然而，那紧张的氛围却依旧如影随形，好似随时都会有危险再度降临。
稍微缓过一口气后，他们便又继续快步前行。
仿佛在他们的潜意识里，一旦停下脚步，那些危险就会不留情地将他们彻底吞噬。
不知走了多久，一阵流声隐约传入了他们的耳中。
此时，两人皆是口干舌燥。
借着黑暗的掩护，他们小心翼翼地摸索着向前走去。
终于，一条蜿蜒流淌的河流出现在了他们的眼前。
杨欢和师妹缓缓地靠近河边，蹲下身子，双手颤抖着捧起河水。
犹豫了一下之后，实在难耐口渴，这才咬着牙喝了下去。
只是，先前在山洞经历的惊心动魄的一幕，依旧让他们心有余悸。
所以每喝一口水，心中都充满了警惕。
眼神不停地扫视着河面，生怕河里会突然窜出什么怪物来。
content_en:
As the gravel on the stone wall continued to fall, the water pool in the open space set off a stormy wave without warning.
The center of the originally calm pool suddenly sunk deeply, and a huge vortex emerged out of thin air.
Everywhere he went, whether it was the gravel beside the pool or the surrounding air, everything was drawn into the endless darkness.
The vortex was getting faster and faster, causing the pool water to make a deafening roar.
In an instant, a loud noise broke the already chaotic situation in the cave.
With this loud noise, a huge monster burst out of the water!
In Yang Huan's past knowledge, such a creature has never been seen before.
Could this be the legendary dragon?
At this moment, the monster's huge eyes were burning with raging anger, staring at the people in front of it.
Immediately afterwards, a powerful suction force suddenly burst out from the monster's body.
The three people who were fighting fiercely were instantly enveloped by this suction force and were sucked into the air without any resistance.
Their bodies struggled and twisted in mid-air, and the shouts from their mouths echoed in the cave.
At this time, Yang Huan and his junior sister also failed to escape the control of this suction force.
The body moved involuntarily in the direction of the monster.
At this critical moment, Yang Huan hurriedly pulled out the two remaining explosives from the bag.
He used all his strength to throw the explosive towards the monster.
That posture, as if this throw really determines the life or death of the two of them.
"Boom"
An explosion suddenly sounded.
In an instant, fire shot into the sky, and a powerful impact spread crazily around.
It was at the moment when the explosion occurred that the suction force seemed to be affected and weakened for a moment.
Yang Huan keenly caught this opportunity, and without hesitation, he grabbed his junior sister tightly, and then ran as fast as he could out of the cave.
At this moment, the only thought in their minds is: escape!
After escaping from the cave, Yang Huan and his junior sister found themselves in a wilderness.
There was endless darkness all around, but they didn't dare to stop at all. They could only grit their teeth and run as hard as they could.
I don't know how long they ran, until both of them were exhausted to the limit, and they had to stop.
However, the tense atmosphere still lingers, as if danger will come again at any time.
After taking a slight breath, they continued to move forward quickly.
It seems that in their subconscious mind, once they stop, those dangers will mercilessly swallow them up completely.
After walking for an unknown amount of time, a faint sound of flowing water reached their ears.
At this time, both of them were thirsty.
Under the cover of darkness, they groped forward cautiously.
Finally, a meandering river appeared in front of them.
Yang Huan and his junior sister slowly approached the river, squatted down, and held up the river water with trembling hands.
After hesitating for a moment, I felt really thirsty, so I gritted my teeth and drank.
However, the thrilling scene they experienced in the cave still left them with lingering fears.
So every time I took a sip of water, my heart was full of vigilance.
His eyes kept scanning the river, for fear that some monster would suddenly emerge from the river.
